findings.title: Keyboard focus shows no ring on the slope-chart rows (Relative strength) and the Rotation map dots
findings.where: Relative strength tab (Sector stocks slope chart, g.sl) and Rotation tab (map, g.pt), light and dark, any width
findings.steps: Open Relative strength, press Tab until focus reaches a slope row (g.sl role=button), or call el.focus({focusVisible:true}); read getComputedStyle: :focus-visible matches true but outline-style none. Same for g.pt on Rotation (33 stops each per 260 Tab presses, probe f4.js).
findings.expected: Decision 12/13: Tab shows a grey 2 px ring on every focusable element of the page
findings.actual: No ring at all (outline none 3px). Cause: sector.css:230 '.slope .sl{outline:none}' and :271 '.rrg .pt{outline:none}' have the same specificity as and come after the new :focus-visible rule at sector.css:113 (.sl:focus-visible,.pt:focus-visible), so they win. Chart dots (circle.dt), .ovx-dot and every other kind do show the ring.
findings.evidence: probe f5.js: rs g.sl {fv:true, os:none}; rot g.pt {fv:true, os:none}; ov g.ovx-dot {os:solid 2px rgb(107,107,107)}; /tmp/.../check2/agents_20261127-sector-r2-brdt/f4.js output 'rs ... bad 33 g.circle noring'
